_comment: Cards that exist only for the retargeting test (tests/unit/targets/test_choose_new_targets.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_ricochet` is Wild Ricochet at {R}; `t_swat` is Deflecting Swat's second sentence; `t_misdirect` is 115.7a's mandatory change without Misdirection's single-target restriction; `t_scatter` is Boltbender's 'any number of spells and/or abilities' on an instant; `t_twin_zap` has two targets, so one can be kept while the other moves; `t_their_zap` targets a creature its caster's opponent controls, so legality has a side.

cards.name: Test Ricochet
cards.oracle_text: You may choose new targets for target instant or sorcery spell. Then copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.

cards.name: Test Swat
cards.oracle_text: You may choose new targets for target spell or ability.

cards.name: Test Misdirect
cards.oracle_text: Change the target of target spell.

cards.name: Test Scatter
cards.oracle_text: You may choose new targets for any number of spells and/or abilities.

cards.name: Test Twin Zap
cards.oracle_text: Test Twin Zap deals 1 damage to each of two target creatures.

cards.name: Test Their Zap
cards.oracle_text: Test Their Zap deals 3 damage to target creature an opponent controls.
